axis: a bare procedure for reaching an end → a plan whose intricacy is itself conspicuous

members.tone: The elaborateness is the point and also the catch: a plan worked out in enough system and detail that the working-out itself draws notice, where *system* names only the method.
Purely technical - a single move settled in advance and belonging to the team's game, passing no verdict on whether the plan is any good.
The flattest member, a procedure or process identified only by the objective it is meant to obtain, with none of *scheme*'s insistence on intricacy.
Adoption is what it adds - the plan has been taken up and stands as the settled course of whoever holds it, one person as readily as a whole social group.
